notes.title: V2.5.0 - Patches & Changes
notes.notes:
V2.5.0

Updates brought to you by Binary. AKA Aiden.
Spent all of today on this so hope it betters the smogs expereince!

MAJOR BUG FIXES:
Fixed Windows 11 crashes, or so I hope. still waiting for QA to test, but its fixed it for me.
Let me know if you still have crashes on Windows 11!

EDIT:
MAJOR FOUND BUGS:
Currently a bug has been found.
Sometimes the Credits scene decides its not its day to load, when it does this you must ALT + F4 the game.
I am working on a new patch tomorrow that will hopefully cover this just found bug and some others.

BUG FIXES:
[olist]
 V-Sync no longer speeds up the main menu camera rotation
 Main menu camera no longer moves slightly up on Y-axis with rotation.
 Cinematic Mode now has working exit binds
 Cinematic Mode no longer throws internal errors on load
 Loading percentage has now been fixed (Math for this previously was wrong)
 Camera no longer moves while you are in the exit menu. (please note the exit menu does not pause the game!)
 Fixed the phone animations not being aligned with delta time
 Fixed the movement not being aligned with delta time
 Fixed the Save Button in the load save menu from overlapping the options menu.
 Fixed loading a save crashing the game
 Fixed AutoLoad not auto loading saves
[/olist]

Added:
[olist]
 Audio sliders to both the main menu, and in-game menu.
Audio only saves changes from the main menu, not within the game. although it can be changed from in-game. (this is why i need to re-write the saving API)
 Added a version indicator to the main menu
[/olist]

Changes:
[olist]
 Edited the legal text on Main Menu to not take up 80% of the bottom
 Edited the Game Exit Menu options, subtitles are now named Closed Captions, following work on captions for the game.
(a lot of people don't know this, but you can access closed captions from within the games exit menu!)
 Edited Discord rich presence from "Content Creator Build" (old) to "Early Access" (new)
 Changed Steam rich presence (see below)
 - Arrived At Smogs = Main Menu
 - Starting The Night Shift = Phoneguy, or pre-phoneguy
 - On The Night Shift {night_time}AM = past phone call, night started
[/olist]

NOTICE:
The Saving scripts will eventually be completely re-written, just a heads up! this will cause data too go boom, unless i make an old data converter, which i might.
This all is well into the future however.


Removed:
[olist]
 Funny Modes have been removed for complicating internal scripting (may add them back in the future)
[/olist]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE HAS ARRIVED!
notes.notes:
THANK YOU ALL 1,164 WISHLISTERS!!!!

Hey fellas! Today is the day for Five Nights At Smog's Release! We have released it under Early Access on the Steam Store Page.

Now its good to mention, this game is not finished, even though its Early Access.
I will be pushing bug fixes and updates over the summer as more people send in reviews on the game, using these i will hopefully be able to make the game better!

PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW!
Thumbs up or down! I need feedback to continue this project, even list some cool ideas you have for the game too! I need some help from the community!!

Thank you all for making this release happen!!!

Early Access is only ONE night.

Currently Known Bugs:
Credits Scene may crash the game, sometimes.

Things I Want To Change:

Poutine Monster has bad walking animations for when he's in the office.

Wide Screen is locked at 1080, which is fine, however there is no barrier at the games bounds, so the mouse can move off the game, which is game breaking.

Power Usage meter commits death after a monster attack and breaks.

Add more gameplay, add nights, and lore.

notes.title: July 8th - OFFICIAL EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hey fellas! 

It's Aiden, from Togi Studios.

Over the past couple of months I've left people waiting, and for too long.

Let me elaborate.

I am the sole person working on this project currently, as the others don't have the resources to.
So for all this time, since about April, I've been doing everything for this game solo.
We have had some "internal" arguments and we no longer have Benjamin on the team (he will still be credited), so its been max, whos been making the graphics, and me, doing everything else.

So that's why it's taken so long. I also got burnt out for about 2 months, but when I checked the wish lists I realized I cant let you all down, not all 800 wish-listers.

So over the past couple of days I have been testing, debugging, and adding to the game.
So here's the release expectations:
1. Early Access
2. Only ONE night (until later releases)
3. Possible minor/some major bugs
4. Crappy AI, that I had no time to re-script

I've done my best as a single entity could, so please, if you have any feedback give it to us on our discord or steam community, it means more than you know, leave a review, bad or good on release, to let us know a path you'd like the game to take, things you'd like to see, or bugs you'd like to be fixed. It's also good to mention that right now we don't have any set direction for Smogs.

Some people also seem to like the OST for Smogs! And thank you if you do, I worked pretty hard on them!
Upon release all OSTs will be released on our YouTube channel! We will also release the FULL Smog's Theme Song on our YouTube at release, a OST not in-game but that will be used in later trailers!

Again, hardset release is July 8th. I have already submitted the build to steam, so you can trust me this time when I say July 8th.

Sorry to everyone who I have kept waiting this time. And I am especially sorry for the low expectations of early access, but I hope we can work together with our community to bring this game to what we all want it to be.

- Aiden C. Desjarlais, FRGames Management & Founder of Togi Studios

notes.title: An Update From The Developers
notes.notes:
Good morning/afternoon everyone!

id like to quickly announce that we have changed the game name to
Five Nights At Smog's
We felt it fit the game better.
But fear not, the game is still within the Smog's Poutinerie Franchise!

Continuation,
We at ForReal game studios have been hard at work developing FNASP.

We wanted to update all of our 300+ wish listers (thank you!) that the game is on track to be released in Early Access in Q2, around the end of April going into March. Our planned, but not set Early Access release, is April 27th. There is no promises that we can make this date. 

We as a team at FRGames are working everyday making sure you guys get what you came for.

Thanks to everyone for wish listing this game, it means a lot to us, to go from a school project, to forming a studio, to then releasing a game on steam. all with what was in a month. 


We want to make sure you guys get what you wish listed for, but we just need time, as hard working students, we don't get a lot of it.

But be not afraid, as this game is still, everyday, being worked on behind the scenes.
from voicings, to music, to game mechanics.

And we now have plans to add Subtitles to the game, and closed captions.
We feel all games should have this, and we aren't going to forget about them.

Oh, and huge shout out to Aldo Tinoc for the new Smog's Art!

- The FRGames Team
